en.answer: Even if there are no monsters in the Extra Monster Zones when <<13033>> on the field is destroyed by a card effect, its effect will activate and create a Chain. (Since there are no monsters in the Extra Monster Zones, the effect is not applied.)
en.question: If a <<13033>> on the field is destroyed by a card effect, will its effect that sends all monsters in the Extra Monster Zone to the Graveyard activate even if there are no monsters in the Extra Monster Zones?
